scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
He can guide you along
the correct path...

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
Oh? Are you one of our Novice Society?
You're looking good.

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
You look full of energy...
You seem strong enough to endure the test.

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text: I know a way to become stronger. Are you willing you try it?
No, I'm okay now.
I want to be stronger!

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
If you are satisfied with mediocrity, I can't help you.
Live a normal life then.

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
Good!
A legend in the Novice world has disappeared to do something in Comodo.
You should find him.

scripts.speaker: Esseray
scripts.text:
He can guide you along
the correct path...

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Sh --------- !!
Be quiet please.
You'll scare the fish.
Hmm... 'scuse me...

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Aaaaaaak!!
What are you doing?
I told you be quiet!
They're swimmin' away bacause of the noise~

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
(-- sh--aking --)
Who... are you?
Why are you disrupting my fishing?
I have a delivery from Esseray...

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
What? Esseray? Esseray?
Hmm! I know him...
Esseray... Esseray... hmm.

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Ahhhh --- !! ----- Ahhhh ---!!
Got it! --- Got it!
^0000FFA member of Novice Society in Aldebaran.^000000
Esseray, right? Wrong?
No he isn't
Yes, right

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text: Hu hu~ my sense is still alive...

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text: So what do you want from me?

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
What?! He isn't?
Then where is Esseray from?

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
What -------- !!
That isn't important, right?

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Then -------- !!
Why did you come here?
- You explain why you're here. -

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text: Hmm... it is an easy and hard question at the same time.
- You hear a voice complaining about something. -

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text: Esseray! Such a son of a %@&$# spoiling my vacation...

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Haaaaa~
My poor life~
Ahhh~ so many problems.

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Too ~ hard. Hey, little kid!
What's your name?
{0}, how about you?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: My name is Nodor! Nodor.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Hey! I can see what you are thinking about in your face~

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Since my name is Nodor I've been made fun of my whole life.
Condor and Odor...
Don't try to fool me.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Whatever the reason is... you are here!
Let's get together to go further.
Come again after a while~
- Talk to him again. -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Emmhmm ----- !!
- Nodor gives you a suspicious look. -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Didn't you know that the ^0000FFSuper Novice^000000 was excellent?
- Nodor asks with confidence. -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hey! Super Novice~
Do you know who I am?
What are you talking about?!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Heh...
You've got a lot of nerve, don't you?
- This guy is a weirdo. -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hey! Super Novice ~
I will make you stronger!
So will you believe what I tell you?
I won't follow you.
Why not? kehehe~

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Refusing? Don't you want to be strong?
I'd love to do nothing too.
Just let me fish if you want to go.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Emmhmm~ Do I sound harsh?
Hmm, I can't help using such words.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Don't sweat it.
It's no problem for me to teach you to be stronger.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Great~!
What is your issue?
You don't know how to be stronger. Right?
Yes, I can't get stronger.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hhhmmm ~!
There's a way to do it...
It is dangerous, but I can
tell you how.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
I'll only do this on one condition. You do not ask anything and you do everything I tell you!
How about it?
Are you willing to do this?
No, I will not!
Let's do this!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
To be strong is the only way to live!
Do you want to be a weakling forever?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
I will give you a tip.
You can't always be right.
Sometimes you need to check your ego and listen to others.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
All right --------- !!
Your passion will make you stronger.
You calm?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
What I want you to do is...
Hunt 1,000 monsters.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Do you know what this is for?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: You know what a ^FF0000{0}^000000 monster is, right?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hunt 1,000!
Do not say you can't do this!
I know that's a lot of monsters, but they're so weak!
Are you kidding me?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Huh huh~!
Rembember, no questions!
Don't come back until you've hunted 1,000.
Hey, Nodor!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Oh my god!
So frightened... let me see?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hey! Super Novice!
Didn't I say to hunt 1,000?
Don't come back until you have.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Have you hunted all 1,000 already?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
You are better than I thought.
Anyway, what was the monster that I told you to hunt?
Poring
Lunatic
Fabre
Picky
Baphomet

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Heheh? Can you seriously hunt Baphomet alone?
Don't tell a lie!! I will hit you!!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Don't tell a lie!
I didn't tell you to hunt this!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: keheheheheheh~

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: You annoyed me so I made you do this task...

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Wow! You actually hunted all 1,000?
I guess I can't question your passion to be stronger.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Okay! So far so good.
I will let you know how to overcome your strength deficiencies.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Oh! You already came here?
Didn't you say you have something to handle?
You have enough passion but...
you need to learn patience.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Hhhhhhhhhh~

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Oh sorry! Sorry!
I got a letter from my brother a long time ago, will you read my letter for your information?
Yes, I will
No, I won't

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: You should read more!
Tsk*... Ok...
- He throws a bundled letter at you. -

Dear Bro. Nodor,
 
Hey Bro, it's your brother Nudor. How have you been? The reason I'm writing this letter is...
I need money for food. You've got so much money, so help me out.

If you don't... Remember last time you %$&*@*&%$...
- The letter is crumpled, so you can't read more. -
I'm still in the Schwarzwald Republic.
~ Nudor
- You get an uneasy feeling from reading this letter. -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hu~u~
Hmm, I only have one brother and he's always asking for money.
It's got to be my fame... T_T
- Now you really have an uneasy feeling. -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Hey- Super Novice {0}!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: You can give some to my bro. He's up in the airship.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Have you visited already?
How much money should I give?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Oh, you didn't go there yet?
Give him a little, ya~

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
100,000 zeny is okay~
1,000,000 zeny is okay~
10,000,000 zeny is okay~

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hey, have you gone there?
I got another message from my bro.

Bro, someone gave me...
{0} Zeny.
You do care about me...
~ Nudor
He seemed so hungry...

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
By the way...
{0} Zeny is so little considering my celebrity status, don't you think?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Anyway~
{0} Zeny...
Don't you think you gave him too little? My reputation is gonna take a hit now.
Hey...

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Wow, you've got my point already?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
I think you are right.
This test is about your ability to open someone else's sympathy.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
I mean your consuming habit and your gut...
Hahahaha!
Hey, that's not my...

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Hmm? Ah...
I almost forgot to tell
you how to exceed your limit,
didn't I?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Eh-hem! I was not just killing time after I sent you!!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: What the? --- ah? --- !!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Watch out!! A bunch of Golems are running after us!
We... have to run...!!!
What?!
Um?

- You look around, and -
- there is nothing behind you. -
- When you are about to doubt... -

- You ask Nodor once -
- again in your fright... -

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
You've still got some skill points that aren't used up.
I can't make you stronger until you use those points.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Puhahahahahahahahahahah!!
Good! You scared yet?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Sorry for scaring you!
I think our duty and mission as Novices is to make days joyful.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Well then, don't you feel something just changed?
Feel your body lighter than before...?
Or more powerful?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Oh--- My--- (tut,tut,tut)!!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Mr. Sieu Ngu --
Not to be mean, but
you are a little dull...
Don't you feel different now?
What are you talking about?
I got it!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Eh--- right, you are dull, aren't you?
You already exceeded your limit.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
You can be stronger than before.
Wasn't it your dream?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Ok~!
Now march to the world and live as a Novice and enjoy your free, happy life!
That's it!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
(Pouting) ------------- !!
So you're finally back.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: To celebrate this new Novice comrade, I've prepared some equipment to give you --

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Don't forget to make sure that you have enough ^FF0000inventory^000000 to take these items from me.
And don't say I didn't warn you either.
Yes, let me check my inventory.
I'm good, show me.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Well, well!
You know! Have no regrets.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
There are what I used to wear when I was younger,
but they are still good.
Second-hand stuff, huh?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Give them back to me.
How can you react like that when I offer you my possessions?

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
I...
I can't take back what I already gave away.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Now I am going to say greetings again.

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text: Let Super Novice {0} be blessed with the Super Novice Guardian!

scripts.speaker: Nodor
scripts.text:
Don't forget that you are a Novice.
Be a Novice always!
The aim of life is to have a nice and normal time!

scripts.speaker: Fishing Novice
scripts.text:
Hush!
Please be quiet because you'll
scare all the fish away.

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
Hey, are you... Mr. Nudor?

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
Eeeeeh?! Who wants to know?
Do I know you?
- You explain to Nudor why you have come to see him. -

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Aha! You've come to give me some pocket money in place of my bro~

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Wowowow~~ How much did he give you?

- Nudor stares with twinkling -
- eyes, holding out his hands. -
- How much do you want to give? -
I have no money
Give 100,000 Zeny
Give 300,000 Zeny
Give 1,000,000 Zeny
Give all the money you have

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
- crying -
I hate Nodor --- !
I hate you too --- !

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Lovely~~ Did he give you {0} Zeny? That's pretty much!

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Oh... oh my gosh, are you really giving me all the Zeny you have? Really?

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: What? But where is {0} Zeny?
No, not really...
Give it all

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Pshaw! How disappointing!

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Eh? But you don't have any money. You're so poor, huh?

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
Woa~!! {0} Zeny! This helped me so much~ Tehee~
I can't believe it...

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Did you know? You're really handsome~

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: I need to tell you, you are really... really~ beautiful.

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
- You feel like you're being -
- tricked, so go back to Nodor. -

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: I cannot believe that my bro sent me money... I love it~

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
Ooooops!
{0}, hush --- !!

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text: Don't tell Nodor about this~~

scripts.speaker: Nudor
scripts.text:
Ahhh~ I have no money to buy any food.
I'm hungry, but I have no idea when Brother is coming...
